caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects placed side by side against a plain, light background. Both objects feature a teardrop or oval shape with a large hollow center and decorative tops. The object on the left is shown in a three-quarter view, highlighting its depth. It is predominantly a warm brown color, with visible wood grain and carved patterns. The top of the object has a ridged, leaf-like motif, and its sides are decorated with small notched or scalloped carvings. The face includes additional engraved geometric and leaf designs near the base. The object on the right is depicted in a front-facing view. It shares a similar overall shape and coloration but has a simpler decorative pattern with a plain wooden texture. The top edge echoes the leaf-like motif, and a rectangular wooden bar is visible at the top center. Both objects are rendered with realistic shading and meticulous attention to the texture and grain of the wood.
title: Stirrup
